subject: geography
title: Climate Change: Causes & Effects 🌍

concepts.def: Natural shifts in Earth's orbit, tilt and wobble over millennia.
Eruptions release ash and aerosols that can cool the climate.
Variations in solar output that slightly alter Earth's temperature.
Burning coal, oil and gas releases stored carbon as CO₂.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Climate has always changed due to:

• Milankovitch cycles — Earth's orbital wobbles
• Volcanic eruptions — block sunlight short-term
• Sunspots — vary solar energy output

These explain past ice ages.

Since the Industrial Revolution, humans have:

• Burned fossil fuels (cars, factories)
• Cut down forests (Amazon)
• Expanded agriculture (cattle release CH₄)

CO₂ levels are now 420+ ppm — highest in 800,000 years.

Climate change is causing:

• Sea-level rise (~3.3 mm/yr)
• Extreme weather (storms, droughts)
• Glacial retreat and ice melt
• Threats to agriculture and biodiversity

We respond with mitigation AND adaptation.

mcqs.q: Which is a NATURAL cause of climate change?
options: Burning coal
Milankovitch cycles
Cattle farming
Deforestation

mcqs.q: What is the difference between mitigation and adaptation?
options: They mean the same thing
Mitigation reduces causes; adaptation copes with effects
Adaptation reduces causes; mitigation copes with effects
Both increase emissions

mcqs.q: What is the enhanced greenhouse effect?
options: It is the hole in the ozone layer letting in more sun.
The greenhouse effect is entirely man-made and harmful.
Sea level rises because of underwater volcanoes pushing it up.
The strengthening of the natural greenhouse effect by human activities (mainly burning fossil fuels) which add CO2 and other gases to the atmosphere.

mcqs.q: Why can a cold winter NOT disprove climate change?
options: A really cold winter proves global warming is not happening.
Climate change only happens in summer.
Climate is the long-term statistical average; a single cold winter is a weather event. Climate change is the trend in averages and extremes over decades, not the absence of cold days.
It is the hole in the ozone layer letting in more sun.

mcqs.q: What causes global sea level rise?
options: It is the hole in the ozone layer letting in more sun.
Sea level rises mainly because Arctic sea ice is melting.
Sea level rises because of underwater volcanoes pushing it up.
Two main factors: thermal expansion of warming seawater, and the melting of land-based ice (glaciers and ice sheets) adding water to oceans.
